visual.narrative_core.core_visual_contrast: vast celestial geography versus tiny ordinary friendship actions
visual.narrative_core.relationship_arc: morning meetup -> shared errands/meals -> spontaneous afternoon extension -> sunset pause -> goodbye
visual.narrative_core.midpoint: Frame10 spontaneous detour to old cloud market
visual.narrative_core.visual_emotional_peak: Frames17-18 sunset cloud sea and splitting the last snack
visual.narrative_core.ending: Frame20 reduces the vast day to shoes, empty wrapper, wooden hairpin and remaining dusk

visual.shot_progression.scale_arc: close selfie -> residential medium/wide -> market mixed scales -> extreme-wide sunset climax -> close residue
visual.shot_progression.interaction_density: meaningful friend interaction appears regularly but does not dominate every frame
visual.shot_progression.frame01_rule: natural selfie with clearly readable P01 face; friends enter casually
visual.shot_progression.frame17_rule: largest world-scale daily-life image; P02 temporarily takes P01's image-jade and stays behind the camera, leaving only a dusty-pink sleeve/hand/device-edge fragment at the frame edge; P01/P03/P04 remain three distant off-center figures continuing to watch/chat/lean without looking toward camera; dusk sun stays off-axis or partly outside frame, distant city loses contrast in atmospheric haze, and ordinary-device backlight preserves clipped highlights/underexposure instead of golden HDR or poster polish

visual.capture_grammar.device: P01 handheld image-jade album device; friend-taken/placed shots only when diegetically justified; Frame17 is explicitly P02 temporarily handholding P01's device, with P02 remaining behind camera and only a sleeve/hand/device-edge fragment allowed as camera-owner evidence
visual.capture_grammar.photo_feel: realistic private mobile-album immediacy, slight imperfection, natural skin texture, non-cinematic posing; Frame17 explicitly favors ordinary-device exposure loss and atmospheric depth over golden-hour HDR, rim-light polish, or fantasy tourism imagery
visual.capture_grammar.composition: subject-first casual framing with lived-in background; avoid symmetrical poster composition; Frame17 must keep asymmetric friend-taken framing, P01/P03/P04 small and off-center against the vast cloud sea, visible P02 edge evidence, natural railing/clothing occlusion, no subject looking or turning for camera, sun off-axis or outside frame, softened distant skyline, and no tourism-poster lineup
visual.capture_grammar.modern_budget: device metaphor is the primary modern-like element; visible scene content remains >90% old-world celestial
visual.capture_grammar.continuity: P01/P02/P03/P04 identities and clothing anchors remain stable; no identity master is claimed before Visual Lock
